title: Add hotcrm submodule as real-world metadata example in console
body:
Integrates [hotcrm](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm) as a git submodule and wires its 6 plugin metadata sets (CRM, Finance, Marketing, Products, Support, HR) into the ObjectUI console so ~95 enterprise business objects render live in the UI.

### Submodule & Workspace

- Added hotcrm at `examples/hotcrm`
- Added `examples/hotcrm/packages/*` to pnpm workspace; excluded the monorepo root to prevent turbo from running hotcrm's own build pipeline

### Metadata Bridge (`examples/hotcrm-bridge.js` + `.d.ts`)

Hotcrm plugins store objects as `{ name: ObjectDef }` maps; the console expects arrays. The bridge extracts and flattens them:

```js
export const hotcrmObjects = allPlugins.flatMap((plugin) =>
  Object.values(plugin.objects || {}),
);
```

The bridge is intentionally `.js` with a companion `.d.ts` — hotcrm targets a different `@objectstack/spec` revision that produces strict-mode errors. This keeps `tsc` from traversing the submodule source tree while Vite/esbuild handles transpilation normally.

### Deduplication

Both the existing CRM example and hotcrm define `account`, `contact`, `opportunity`, `product`, `order`. `mergeObjects()` preserves existing objects (which carry seed data) and appends only unique hotcrm objects.

### `@hotcrm/ai` Stub

The CRM plugin's action files import from `@hotcrm/ai` (no pre-built `dist/`). A lightweight stub at `examples/hotcrm-stubs/ai.ts` satisfies the import via a Vite alias — AI utilities aren't needed for UI metadata rendering.

### Result

Console app switcher shows 9 apps (3 existing + 6 from hotcrm):

![Console showing HotCRM apps](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/829bcf8d-cf3b-48a9-a18a-3aab5603af07)
